desc.hr: Pupnat je jedan od pet sela na Korčuli koje čuva tradicionalni kumpanija, mađarski oružani ples koji se izvodi ljeti.
a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer
the grape harvest in Carsko Polje is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island

Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.

A walk through the vineyards and olive groves of the field below the village, passing the old church of Gospa od Carskog Polja and the wine cellar, is one of the most pleasant short walks on the island.
The fortified house at the village entrance offers views over the whole valley and out to sea. Worth a look from the outside, even if not open to visitors.

desc.hr: The road from Čara down to Zavalatica and Žitna passes through the vineyards of Carsko Polje with fine views. A good short excursion by bicycle or scooter.
Čara is well positioned for walking east to Pupnat or west to Smokvica along the island road and old paths through the hills.
